en: Color-tinted historic postcard view of a landscaped park or boulevard. A central grassy island with flowerbeds and a statue on a white pedestal is framed by curving paths and tree‑lined avenues. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. The printed caption identifies the scene as 'Nassausingel' in Nijmegen. Publisher and date information are printed along the bottom margin.
